scope: Harbourline Genomics, a fictional Singapore research sequencing network: 40 sequencers across 8 Singapore planning areas (Queenstown, Novena, Outram, Jurong East, Tampines, Woodlands, Seletar, Changi) x 5 assay lines
data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; aggregate per instrument and day; no patient, sample-level or genomic records; not for clinical use

grains.RAW.SEQUENCERS: one row per sequencer (lab site x assay)
grains.RAW.SEQUENCER_DAILY: one row per sequencer per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.REAGENT_KITS: one row per sequencer (reagent kit snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide sample volume FORECAST; phasing ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.QC_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic run QC troubleshooting SOPs (one per assay and failure mode)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.SEQUENCING_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.SEQUENCING_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, sequencer, failure-mode and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (sequencers, daily samples, confirmed failed runs by sequencer, failed-run risk, run summaries loaded) over an existing Snowflake data source
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: S3 PutObject of run-summary batches -> S3 (runs/) -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_RUNS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_RUN_ALERT logs new QC_FLAG events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.fail_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed failed run in next 7 days) per sequencer, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
